hero.title: Ivo Iuliano
hero.subtitle: Maestro Liutaio
hero.description: Violini, viole, violoncelli e strumenti barocchi realizzati a mano. Combinando metodi tradizionali con una profonda comprensione del suono.

about.title: Chi Sono
about.content: Sono nato a Duisburg, in Germania, nel 1970, dove ho vissuto fino al 1981. Mi sono formato presso la Scuola Internazionale di Liuteria (IPIALL) di Cremona dal 1994 al 1998, diplomandomi sotto la guida del Maestro Ernesto Vaia. Dal 1999 il mio lavoro si è concentrato sulla viola da gamba e sull’assetto storico degli strumenti della famiglia del violino. Dal 2014 mi dedico prevalentemente a strumenti moderni, valorizzando l’esperienza maturata nel lavoro sugli strumenti storici. Attualmente vivo e lavoro a Rovereto, in provincia di Trento.

violin.title: Violino
violin.description: Violini artigianali con suono ricco, sfumato ed eccellente equilibrio in tutti i registri.

viola.title: Viola
viola.description: Viole con tono caldo e scuro e notevole proiezione, perfette per musica da camera e solistica.

cello.title: Violoncello
cello.description: Violoncelli con bellissimo colore, intensità e un'ampia tavolozza dall'oscurità intima alla grande apertura.

baroque.title: Strumenti Barocchi
baroque.description: Viola da gamba e strumenti della famiglia del violino in assetti storici.

testimonials.title: Cosa Dicono i Musicisti
testimonials.subtitle: La fiducia di musicisti professionisti in tutto il mondo

ahonen.quote: I spent a long time looking for a violin capable of producing exactly the kind of sound I imagine when I play. Luckily, this summer I came across an instrument made by Ivo Iuliano in 2024. It is a deep-, healthy-sounding and richly nuanced violin that performs excellently and with great balance across all registers. I keep discovering new qualities in the instrument, and I feel it offers endless possibilities in terms of color and expression. It has become my trusted instrument, one that carries beautifully in any concert hall.
ahonen.author: Iidamari Ahonen

gothoni.quote: Besides my 2015 Ivo Iuliano violin, all the instruments build by Maestro Iuliano I’ve had the pleasure to play and hear, combine all the advantages of an excellent modern instrument - easy to play, healthy strong sound, carrying extremely well in a big hall - with the mysterious and profound sounds found normally only in great old instruments by Stradivari, Guarneri, Amati etc. I have by far not reached the limits of expression with this violin. On the contrary I keep getting surprised by new hidden qualities, that were just waiting to be discovered. What a great pleasure to be on this kind of endless journey with such a wonderful instrument!
gothoni.author: Mark Gothoni
gothoni.role: Professor für Violine, Universität der Künste Berlin, Mozart Piano Quartet

furusawa.quote: My violin, built in 2015 by Ivo Iuliano has opened many doors for me. I don't think all of it would have been possible without it. Having never been so enthusiastic about a modern violin, my opinion is being shared by so many colleagues and audiences.
furusawa.author: Kaori Furusawa

rohde.quote: Die Instrumente von Ivo Iuliano packten mich ab der ersten Sekunde. Ein sehr inniges, beseeltes sowie kraftvolles Tembre aus einer großen Epoche, das einem aus dem Herzen spricht und in den Saal hinaus strömt!
rohde.author: Hartmut Rohde
rohde.role: Professor für Viola, Universität der Künste Berlin, Mozart Piano Quartet

segawa.quote: Les violons de maître Ivo Iuliano: Tout simplement fantastique!
segawa.author: Sachiko Segawa

konishi.quote: Since playing my Iuliano violin (2017) I am finally feeling able to use a whole palate of expression, likewise as a soloist with big symphony orchestra and in chamber music ensembles or in duo with piano. It is an instrument for life!
konishi.author: Mao Konishi

todicescu.quote: This outstanding viola was crafted by Ivo Iuliano for me in 2019. It has a warm and projecting sound which is ideal for solo and chamber music and is a high quality instrument.
todicescu.author: Alex Todicescu

pasquier.quote: La rencontre avec mon alto puis avec Ivo dans le Nord de l'Italie furent 2 moments forts dans ma carrière. L'impression de renouer enfin avec les immenses instruments italiens anciens fut renforcée en voyant la façon dont il travaille dans son atelier. Outre la beauté du son, sa puissance, sa rondeur et sa profondeur, le plus important pour moi reste le timbre, et de ce point de vue aussi mon alto a une âme. Merci Ivo.
pasquier.author: Cyrill Pasquier

rome.quote: I am honestly grateful to be one of the musicians playing the instrument made by Ivo Iuliano. It is a beautiful work with unlimited sound diversity, very comfortable to play, always projecting sound clearly. It is great experience to perform in any kind of acoustics. Looking forward every new day working with it. Very happy....
rome.author: Maja Rome

kang.quote: I've been playing his viola da gamba for more than 10 years already. It has a remarkable projection and resonance. Direct and focused sound on top string, warm and rich sound on the lower strings. It is not so much sensitive as strong against the weather. (I was a bit worried about the Korean extreme weather.) The more I play, the more I love it!
kang.author: Jiyun Kang

leon.quote: Estoy muy contento con mi violonchelo barroco que Ivo construyó para mi hace algunos años. Su sonoridad es maravillosa.
leon.author: Felipe León Rojas
leon.role: Cello and viola da gamba player

susuri.quote: Ich habe mich sofort in dieses Cello verliebt. Dieses junge Instrument hatte von Anfang an eine schöne Klangfarbe und Intensität. Es hat riesige Möglichkeiten und eine große Farbpalette, von der intimsten Dunkelheit bis zu großer Offenheit und Stärke! Es ist einfach Cello! Es läßt Zärtlichkeit und 'Unhöflichkeit' zu und reagiert gut und sofort. Schöne und klare Resonanzen kommen im Konzertsaal einfach zum Ausdruck, egal ob Solo oder Kammermusik gespielt wird. Ich bin einfach wunschlos zufrieden!
susuri.author: Jana Susuri

franetovich.quote: I feel incredibly grateful to have Ivo as my luthier. He knows my violin so well that every time he puts his hands on it, it improves almost instantly. The work he did on the neck last year truly transformed the instrument.
franetovich.author: Mjlla Franetovich
